title: Started a space exploration game rendered in ASCII - still just a tech demo
author: Afraid-Act424
selftext:
This is my first post here. Since yesterday I've been messing around with a little project that for now is more of a tech demo than anything else: Spascii.

The basic idea is pretty obvious from the name 😅 a space game with an ASCII aesthetic. I've started laying down a few mechanics - flight, docking, sound, voice (via TTS), and the UI. The long-term goal is something focused on exploration and mining: finding resources and figuring out the right path to push your exploration further.

Nothing crazy on the tech side, just three.js, with the whole 3D scene rendered as ASCII characters (each cell mapped to a glyph by brightness), Kitten TTS for the voices, and Opus 4.8 to glue it all together. Everything is running fully in the browser.

[https://spascii.github.io](https://spascii.github.io)

comments.author: FakeCarbonara
comments.body: love the way space and ASCII match... brilliant combination

replies.author: Afraid-Act424
replies.body: Hey thanks, in a way it leaves a bit more room for the imagination

comments.author: Broad_Pirate12
comments.body: Very cool. Is it compute intensive to render?

replies.author: Afraid-Act424
replies.body: Nope, it can easily render on a smartphone. That said, the UI and controls are only optimized for desktop right now

comments.author: orblabs
comments.body: Very cool ! Wanted to do something with ascii art sometime ago but couldn't settle on the project. You found a perfect match and it already has a ton of style. Good job!

comments.author: kal101246
comments.body: Can you walk through how the that 3d scene rendered as ASCII art works? The aesthetic is fire and I'd love to learn more on how to try it out myself!

replies.author: Afraid-Act424
replies.body:
Thanks! Glad you like the aesthetic.

There's an example right on the three.js website that breaks down exactly how to do it:  
[https://threejs.org/examples/?q=as#webgl\_effects\_ascii](https://threejs.org/examples/?q=as#webgl_effects_ascii)   
[https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/master/examples/jsm/effects/AsciiEffect.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/master/examples/jsm/effects/AsciiEffect.js) 

On top of that base, I added custom vertex colors and a "CRT" post-processing filter (essentially a scanline grid overlayed across the screen) to emulate old-school cathode-ray tube monitors and really push that retro vibe.

comments.author: JuaniSixto
comments.body: I just love it. The game feel, man. Really good! Looking forward to seeing where the exploration/mining loop goes from here. Cheers
